title: AI-Driven 6G-Enabled V2X Communications for Smart and Sustainable Mobility
summary: AI4Africa proposes 6G-V2X networks for connected transport. The system has no deployment, and mobility benefits remain prospective.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: AI4Africa proposes 6G-V2X networks for connected transport. The system has no deployment, and mobility benefits remain prospective. No deployments.
purpose: Coordinate connected vehicles through reliable, intelligent communication.

ratings.reason: Transport and communications operators are intended to improve network and traffic management.
Connected-vehicle users are intended to receive safer and smoother journeys.
Lower congestion and emissions are prospective benefits only.

ai_role.statement: The chapter describes this system as supporting the stated purpose. Its causal contribution to the benefit has not been separately assessed.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 7: AI-Driven 6G-Enabled V2X Communications for Smart and Sustainable Mobility

produced_by: Causal conditions are not established separately in the extracted chapter.
must_hold: Future compatible V2X and 6G communication infrastructure

headline: AI-enabled 6G vehicle communications

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
